data.name: AutosaveBk2Checkbox.ToolTip
data.value: Autosave will export the movie to a .bk2 file instead of saving a .tasproj file.

data.name: FastRewindNum.ToolTip
data.value: How many frames backward to go when you press the rewind button or hotkey, while also holding the turbo hotkey or fast forward hotkey.

data.name: BindMarkersCheckbox.ToolTip
data.value: When enabled, inserting or deleting frames will move any markers that are on future frames by the same amount. Deleting a frame that has a marker will delete the marker.

data.name: ScrollToCenterRadio.ToolTip
data.value: scroll so that the cursor is in the middle of the visible frames.

data.name: PatternPaintAlwaysRadioButton.ToolTip
data.value: Painting in all button columns will be painted as auto-fire, or with their custom pattern, if "Auto-Fire" or "Custom" is selected.

data.name: AlwaysScrollCheckbox.Text
data.value: When following cursor, scroll at every frame

data.name: UndoCountNum.ToolTip
data.value: The maximum number of edit actions TAStudio should keep in the undo history.

data.name: RewindNum.ToolTip
data.value: How many frames backward to go when you press the rewind button or hotkey.

data.name: AutosaveBackupCheckbox.ToolTip
data.value: Autosave will save a movie to the backups folder, with a timestamp in the name, so no file is overwritten. Backup movies will not contain any "greenzone" savestates, which makes them smaller than normal .tasproj files.

data.name: BackupOnSaveCheckbox.ToolTip
data.value: Save a backup .tasproj after each manual file save.

data.name: ScrollSyncCheckbox.ToolTip
data.value: When enabled, scrolling one input roll will scroll all input rolls.

data.name: PatternCustomRadioButton.ToolTip
data.value: Auto-fire buttons will use a custom pattern on newly emulated frames past the end of the movie.

data.name: StatesForMarkersCheckbox.ToolTip
data.value: TAStudio can automatically keep savestates for each marker. If this is enabled, new markers will have savestates enabled by default. Note: The savestate needs to be on the frame before the marker. Thus, making a marker on the current frame will not automatically create a state. (The reason for the state being on the frame before is so that TAStudio does not need to store a screenshot with the savestate.)

data.name: MarkerIconsCheckbox.ToolTip
data.value: If enabled, the frame column will contain an icon on each frame that TAStudio has a marker for.

data.name: MarkerColorCheckbox.ToolTip
data.value: If enabled, the frame column will have a different background color on each frame that TAStudio has a marker for.

data.name: PatternAutoFireRadioButton.ToolTip
data.value: Auto-fire buttons will alternate on/off on newly emulated frames past the end of the movie.

data.name: AutopauseCheckbox.Text
data.value: Automatically pause at end of movie.

data.name: AutosaveIntervalNum.ToolTip
data.value: How many seconds between each time TAStudio automatically saves. If neither "Save as ..." boxes are checked, autosave will overwrite whatever file is open. In no file is open, autosave will never do anything.

data.name: label12.Text
data.value: Each movie contains its own savestate settings

data.name: PatternPaintAutoColumnsOnlyRadioButton.ToolTip
data.value: Painting in auto-fire columns will be painted as auto-fire, or with their custom pattern, if "Auto-Fire" or "Custom" is selected.

data.name: ScrollSyncCheckbox.Text
data.value: Sync scroll across all input rolls

data.name: MarkerColorCheckbox.Text
data.value: Denote markers with color on frame column

data.name: AlwaysScrollCheckbox.ToolTip
data.value: When disabled, "Follow cursor" will not scroll when the cursor is already visible.

data.name: StateColorCheckbox.ToolTip
data.value: If enabled, the background color of a row will be slightly different when TAStudio has a savestate for that frame.

data.name: PatternHoldRadioButton.ToolTip
data.value: Auto-fire buttons will be held on newly emulated frames past the end of the movie.

data.name: StateIconsCheckbox.ToolTip
data.value: If enabled, the frame column will contain an icon on each frame that TAStudio has a savestate for.

data.name: EditInvisibleColumnsCheckbox.Text
data.value: Allow editing hidden columns (with clear, record, paste, etc.)

data.name: ScrollSpeedNum.ToolTip
data.value: How many frames to scroll per tick of the mouse wheel. Set to 0 to use the system default.

data.name: HideWasLagCheckbox.ToolTip
data.value: If unchecked, "Lag frames to hide" will stop hiding lag frames that are past the "greenzone". Put another way, it will not hide frames that TAStudio does not know will still be lag frames when re-emulated.

data.name: OldBranchesCheckbox.ToolTip
data.value: When enabled, branches cannot be loaded when "Recording mode" is off; instead TAStudio will seek to the branch frame. And when "Recording mode" is on, the movie will be truncated at the branch frame after loading a branch.

data.name: ScrollToViewRadio.ToolTip
data.value: scroll the minimum amount needed to make the cursor visible.

data.name: IncludeFrameNumberCheckbox.Text
data.value: Include frame numbers when copying input.

data.name: ScrollToBottomRadio.ToolTip
data.value: scroll so that the cursor is at the bottom of the visible frames.

data.name: EditInvisibleColumnsCheckbox.ToolTip
data.value: When disabled, inputs that are not visible on the active input roll cannot be edited. This allows you to, for example, insert and delete frames on a roll with player 1's inputs without affecting player 2's inputs, by hiding all columns for player 2. You can hide columns and create/delete input rolls by right-clicking on a column header. Because markers are not associated with any input column, it is recommended that you turn off "Bind markers to input" if you uncheck this box. Otherwise markers may move unexpectedly. This feature is experimental but should be ready for use.

data.name: ScrollToTopRadio.ToolTip
data.value: scroll so that the cursor is at the top of the visible frames.

data.name: HideLagNum.ToolTip
data.value: Hide up to this many lag frames per group of consecutive lag frames. Intended for use in 30FPS games running on 60FPS consoles.
